name: annas-mcp
description: MCP server and CLI for Anna's Archive: search books, ebooks and journal articles by title, author or DOI, and download them
author: Nikita Sokolsky

scripts.test: node --test scripts/check-version.test.mjs scripts/bump-version.test.mjs scripts/release-metadata.test.mjs && node scripts/test-npx-launcher.mjs
scripts.coverage: go test -race -coverprofile coverage.out ./... && node scripts/check-coverage.mjs coverage.out
